substitutions.note: Rye and bourbon are generally interchangeable; rye is spicier, bourbon is sweeter
Citrus bitters can often stand in for each other
Citrus juices can sometimes substitute, though flavor profile will shift
Sugar syrups are generally interchangeable; adjust quantity for rich syrup (use less)
Punt e Mes is more bitter than standard sweet vermouth
Light, aromatized wines — Lillet is sweeter than dry vermouth
Angostura is the most common aromatic bitter
